newsitem.title: USA: U.S corporate bonds quietly track Treasuries lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S corporate bonds quietly track Treasuries lower.

text.p: U.S. corporate high-grade bonds traded slightly lower in line with U.S. Treasuries in subdued trading, dealers said.
"There's been light volume on the street...mostly retail activity," said one high-grade trader. "Secondary activity will probably remain sluggish through the employment numbers."
Spreads to U.S. Treasuries remained unchanged across most maturities, dealers added.
"Spreads were a touch wider at the open but came back in after the (Treasury) market turned lower," another trader said.
